ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of low-intensity (dark/black) pixels concentrated in the central region to high-intensity (white/grey) pixels distributed across the lateral lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central dark pigmentation forms a broad, roughly symmetrical mask around the median notch, extending towards the leading edge. The distal regions of the left and right lobes are primarily high-intensity white with small, low-intensity pixel clusters (mottling) concentrated at the trailing edges and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a narrow vertex angle; depth is shallow relative to the total fluke width, with sharp transition points to the inner lobe edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Visible irregular serration along the entire visible trailing edge; low-amplitude jagged peaks and valleys are most prominent on the distal thirds of both lobes, contrasted against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edge from the notch to the tips, creating a tapered, aerodynamic profile.
